item.title: Pokémon Fire Red Recreated in 3D Using Let’s Go Graphics, Fan Remake Goes Viral
item.description: A fan developer has recreated Pokémon Fire Red as a fully 3D adventure using graphics and animations from Pokémon: Let’s Go, Pikachu! and Let’s Go, Eevee!, offering a glimpse of what the classic might look like with modern visuals.

item.title: Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Worse Than Imagined
item.description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake has been lambasted heavily due to its changes from the original, be them large or subtle, and some Internet users have provided compilations of just a few of the differences, highlighting just how much was actually altered.

item.title: 70% of Male Social VR Users Choose Anime Girl Avatars
item.description: Approximately 70% of male social VR users choose female avatars, according to research highlighted by Japanese broadcaster ABEMA, which interviewed several men who prefer living as cute anime girls in virtual reality.

item.title: Japanese Shop Creates Life-Size Anime Stands That Ride in Your Car
item.description: A Japanese automotive customization shop has unveiled an unusual product allowing anime fans to take their favorite fictional characters on car rides, creating life-size acrylic figures that can be strapped into passenger seats with ordinary seat belts.

item.title: Nara Deer Injuries Hit Record High, Over 70% of Hospitalized Victims Are Foreigners
item.description: Deer-related injuries in Japan’s famous Nara Park have reached a record high in 2026, with foreign nationals accounting for more than 70% of people transported to hospital after encounters with the animals.

item.title: Tokyo’s Akihabara Installs 22 Smart Trash Cans to Combat Tourist Litter
item.description: Tokyo’s famous Akihabara shopping district has installed 22 high-tech trash cans in an effort to combat increasing litter, particularly from tourists visiting the neighborhood’s numerous anime, manga, and video game stores.

item.title: 41.5% of Japanese Middle Schoolers Doubt Benefits of Increased Immigration
item.description: A new survey has revealed that 41.5% of Japanese middle school students do not believe an increase in foreign residents would benefit society, nearly doubling the proportion expressing such views just a few years earlier.

item.title: Ocarina of Time Remake Rabidly Criticized & Bizarrely Sexy
item.description: Aside from the censorship with the Great Fairy, the Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake has been criticized on various different levels, from its occasionally eerie character designs to its horrid modern voice-acting – though, the game does have some oddly sexy moments as well.

item.title: Persona 4 Revival Developers Debated How Thick Chie’s Thighs Should Be
item.description: The developers of Persona 4 Revival have revealed that one of the unexpected challenges during production involved deciding just how thick Chie Satonaka’s thighs should be, with disagreements arising over the character’s appearance in 3D models and illustrations.

item.title: Battlefield 6 Player Sues EA Over Permanent Ban, Wins Account Back in Court
item.description: A Battlefield 6 player has reportedly defeated Electronic Arts in court after being permanently banned from the game for alleged cheating, successfully overturning the punishment and obtaining financial compensation from the publisher.

item.title: Sega Suffers Data Breach Exposing 2.19 Million Email Addresses, Warns of Phishing Attacks
item.description: Japanese gaming giant Sega has confirmed that more than 2.19 million email addresses were exposed in a cyberattack targeting one of its third-party service providers, warning customers to be cautious of fraudulent emails impersonating the company.

item.description: The United States Navy has attracted attention in Japan after one of its official recruitment accounts published a promotional video based on the popular Blend S anime meme, combining footage of American warships with a joke that originally went viral nearly a decade ago.
